title: Smallz - Outside
htmlContent:
Smallz's "Outside" is his best work to showcase his high level of musical skills to the fullest. The vocal performance is nothing but flavor, the songwriting is brilliant and the production is a vibe that truly makes this record beyond music, but just sheer art for the world to enjoy.

The single "Outside" is smooth and flows well with a sound that leaves your body stuck, and lets you vibe endlessly to the record. The songwriting shines with his record making being on full display, with his melodic approach to the vocal working it’s magic to make it a masterpiece that doesn’t slack.
